The court will sustain both objections and exclude the computer business records. Testimony that the defendant kept them on a regular business basis leaves the Rule 803(6) foundation incomplete, because it does not show that the entries were made at or near the time by someone with knowledge as a regular practice, and it does not authenticate the records or the computer process under Rule 901. An out-of-court record offered for its truth remains hearsay unless that foundation, or another specific exemption, is established.

CONFIDENCE: 82
